headline: A first down for the Colts
what_happened: D.Jones threw a short pass to J.Downs for 7 yards, earning a first down which gives them a fresh set of four tries to move the ball.
who: D.Jones and J.Downs led the play, while L.Sneed and C.Jones defended for the Chiefs.
why_it_matters: This is bad news for the Chiefs because it keeps the Colts moving toward the end zone, increasing their chance of winning by 4 percentage points.
